title: HTMXUI Framework Attribute & Grammar Specification
description: Formal machine-readable grammar, attribute rules, element targets, and scope definitions for HTMXUI.

flash.description: In-memory typo-tolerant fuzzy search and filtering engine

form.description: Declarative validation state machine & optimistic UI engine

a11y.description: WAI-ARIA focus trap and roving tabindex engine

hx-state.description: Declares local reactive component state context.

hx-computed.example: hx-computed="{ total: price * qty, isValid: count > 0 }"

hx-effect.description: Runs a side effect function whenever tracked signal dependencies mutate.

hx-model.description: Two-way data binding for form controls.

hx-text.description: Binds element innerText to a reactive expression.

hx-html.description: Binds element innerHTML to a reactive expression.
hx-html.securityWarning: Ensure content is sanitized against XSS.

hx-show.description: Toggles element visibility using CSS display property with transition hooks.

hx-if.description: Structural conditional mounting/unmounting of DOM elements.

hx-for.description: Structural list loop rendering on template elements.
hx-for.syntax: item in items | (item, index) in items

hx-class.description: Conditionally applies CSS classes from an object map or string expression.

hx-style.description: Dynamically sets inline CSS styles from an object map.

hx-on.description: Attaches event listeners with modifiers. Short syntax: @event

hx-validate.description: Declarative input validation rules separated by pipes.

hx-flash-search.description: Binds an input to in-memory typo-tolerant fuzzy search.

hx-flash-filter.description: Binds a filter control to multi-column database filtering.

hx-flash-sort.description: Binds a clickable element to client-side column sorting.

hx-vibe-flip.description: Enables 60fps FLIP layout animation during HTMX swaps or item reordering.

hx-vlt-glare.description: Enables dynamic specular light glare on 3D tilt elements.

hx-vibe-magnetic.description: Enables elastic magnetic snapping to cursor pointer.

hx-vibe-split.description: Kinetic typography engine splitting text into staggered 3D span reveals.

hx-vpx-blast.description: Explosive radial shockwave dispersing surrounding elements with physics impulses.

hx-tick.description: Evaluates a reactive expression on every frame of the 120 FPS game loop ticker.

hx-vibe-stagger.description: Staggers animation delay across children elements.

hx-trap-focus.description: WAI-ARIA compliant modal focus trapping for dialogs and sheets.

scaleui.description: Enables fluid responsive component resizing testing.

scopeVariables.description: Variables accessible inside expressions and event actions

$refs.description: Dictionary of elements tagged with hx-ref="name"

$event.description: The native DOM event in actions

$form.description: Form state object: { valid, dirty, touched, errors }

errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-001: Invalid JSON/JS syntax in hx-state or <script type="application/json" hx-state>
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-002: Circular dependency detected in hx-computed property
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-003: Invalid hx-for expression syntax. Expected 'item in list' or '(item, index) in list'
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-004: Referenced undefined property or store in expression
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-BOLT-005: Possible typo in attribute name (autocorrect suggestion provided)
errorCatalog.HTMXUI-FLASH-001: Flash database queried before initialization or fetch error
